commercialEvidence: Owner-reported delivery remains classified; no private commercial source imported. Independent public snapshots, local prototype and fictional boundaries preserved.
fontLicense: Space Grotesk full upstream font and exact bundled OFL notice/manifest retained; model/ONNX Apache/MIT checks pass. No relicensing/subsetting.
privateFiles: Private context, .env and session/log contents not read or published; only nonsecret integration enable/telemetry flags inspected. Existing authentication used in memory for GET requests and never logged/exported.
inheritedUnpublishedEntireCommits: Configuration/hooks only; no session trace blobs in main ancestry delta. Explicit main-only publication and per-command hook isolation proposed; no checkpoints/session refs authorized.
limitations: Regex/structural audit cannot prove absence of every secret in arbitrary binary or inherited full history
No raw build environment values, provider account IDs, credentials or raw provider logs retained
